article.title: Power of Central Government to review.
article.content: The Central Government may make periodic review and monitor the progress of the implementation of the provisions of this Act by the State Governments.
article.html:
31Power of Central Government to review.

Section 31 · Chapter VII · page 9 of the Act

The Central Government may make periodic review and monitor the progress of the implementation of the provisions of this Act by the State Governments.
